canada.title: ‘Garbage,’ ‘egregious’ ‘an assault’: museum chair warns AI slop on Inuk war hero John Shiwak making rounds
canada.summary: A post purporting to be a true account of Inuk war hero John Shiwak’s WW I military service is circulating and its has chair of the Royal Newfoundland Regiment Museum Frank Gogos calling it out as “garbage.”

canada.title: Northern territories form new cooperative to advance  film industry in the north
canada.summary: Working group will focus on shared priorities such as promoting north as film destination, supporting creation of local film jobs

canada.title: Thomas Markle, father of Meghan, cut off his ankle monitor, DOJ says
canada.summary: TAMPA, Fla. (AP) — The 82-year-old estranged father of Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex, cut an electronic monitoring device off his ankle, just days after his arrest for keeping child sexual abuse material in storage units in California, authorities said Tuesday.

canada.title: 'The editor's here!': CBC journalist stars in viral video with American stand-up Josh Johnson
canada.summary: A CBC News copy editor turned into one half of an unexpected comedy duo in a video posted to social media Tuesday. American comedian Josh Johnson brought Jon Azpiri to the stage to talk cats, disappearing islands and journalism.

canada.title: Man wanted for second-degree murder arrested in Regina: RCMP
canada.summary: Steven Kishayinew, the Prince Albert man accused of killing a 66-year-old man in Rose Valley, Sask., was arrested in Regina, the RCMP said.

canada.title: N.L. man could be barred from entering U.S. due to Trump Facebook comment
canada.summary: A man in St. John’s, N.L., could be barred from ever travelling south of the border after the U.S. Secret Service flagged a Facebook comment he doesn’t even remember making against President Donald Trump.

canada.title: 4 grizzly bears found responsible for killing mother and daughter in Bella Coola
canada.summary: The B.C. Conservation Officer Service says four grizzly bears have been destroyed in connection with an attack near Bella Coola that left a mother and daughter dead.

canada.title: Sask. minister tables workers' comp changes to keep system 'fair, effective and sustainable'
canada.summary: One of the changes will be a 100-per-cent wage reimbursement for time missed to attend injury-related medical treatment.

canada.title: Calgary's 4-year budget proposes 15% property tax hike, rising water rates
canada.summary: City administration released the 2027-2030 budget to the public on Tuesday, and it proposes a double-digit property tax increase to catch up with a growing population and aging infrastructure.

canada.title: New Brunswick’s first data-centre town has thoughts to share
canada.summary: Long before data centre proposals in Lorneville and Miramichi were stirring opposition, and long before the province was grappling with how to regulate the sector, Gus Rioux was marching off to the Grand Falls town office, petition in hand.

canada.title: Montreal man handed life sentence, no parole for 22 years for 2024 murder of pregnant wife
canada.summary: A Quebec court sentenced a Montreal man to life in prison with no chance of parole for 22 years for the 2024 stabbing death of his pregnant wife, Narjes Ben Yedder.

canada.title: Man who pleaded guilty to firing at Jewish school in Montreal given 5.5-year sentence
canada.summary: A man who pleaded guilty to firing shots at a Jewish school in Montreal three years ago has been sentenced to five-and-a-half years in prison. According to the Crown Prosecutor's Office, with time served, Abdirazak Mahdi Ahmed has about 18 months left on his sentence.

canada.title: Port Hawkesbury Mayor Brenda Chisholm-Beaton on how her Cape Breton town has evolved, and what’s next
canada.summary: Chisholm-Beaton is the first woman mayor of Port Hawkesbury, and the first woman mayor on Cape Breton Island.

canada.title: Ontario appoints 8 new regional chairs after controversial rule change lets minister hand-pick appointees
canada.summary: Ontario's municipal affairs minister has appointed eight regional heads of council, following a controversial legislative change that let the Ford government hand-pick appointees who otherwise would have been elected to their position.

canada.title: Ontario student accused of working for Chinese official pleads not guilty in U.S.
canada.summary: An Ontario student accused of working for someone he believed to be a Chinese government official has pleaded not guilty in the United States to making false statements.

canada.title: What's open and closed on Remembrance Day in Winnipeg
canada.summary: Some businesses, services and organizations will be closed or operating at reduced hours for Remembrance Day on Wednesday. Here's a look at what's open and closed in Winnipeg.

canada.title: Halifax man charged for allegedly spiking woman's drink at downtown bar
canada.summary: Police arrived at Durty Nelly's Irish Pub on Argyle Street early Saturday morning and found an unresponsive woman who had become ill after consuming a drink that a man was seen giving her.

canada.title: ‘Things will never be the same’: Wainwright prepares for Remembrance Day after fire
canada.summary: The Alberta town of Wainwright is gearing up for what could be the most solemn Remembrance Day in its recent history, says Mayor Bruce Pugh.

bds.h: Rep. Jim Jordan of Ohio elected to lead House Republicans in the the minority
bds.lede: Rep. Jim Jordan of Ohio won the race Tuesday to serve as House Republican leader as the GOP prepares for its new role in the minority.
rows: ABC News
House Republicans on Tuesday elected Jim Jordan as minority leader for the next Congress, beating Majority Leader Steve Scalise, according to multiple sources.
CP24
Rep. Jim Jordan of Ohio won the race Tuesday to serve as House Republican leader as the GOP prepares for its new role in the minority.
PBS NewsHour
Jordan, who serves as chairman of the House Judiciary Committee, defeated Rep. Steve Scalise of Louisiana in a secret ballot election of Republicans who will serve in the next Congress.
CBS News
Judiciary Committee Chairman Jim Jordan defeated Majority Leader Steve Scalise for the role of minority leader.
The Guardian
As Democrats prepare to take control of Congress, Republicans pick Jordan for last two years of Trump’s presidency
Fox News
Jim Jordan defeated Steve Scalise in a narrow secret ballot to become House GOP minority leader and President Trump's top defender in Congress.
